homepage.hero.kicker.message: Sewa Developer Portal · Government of Sri Lanka

homepage.hero.subtitle.message: Ship lightweight ES modules that run inside the Sewa Citizen shell. The host injects the SDK at runtime — you just declare types and export

homepage.howItWorks.step2.desc.message: Your bundle exports mount(container, runtime). The host calls it when the user opens the mini app.

homepage.howItWorks.step3.desc.message: Vite lib mode outputs a single ES module the shell loads on demand. No SDK bundling.

homepage.howItWorks.title.message: Three steps to a shippable mini app

homepage.howItWorks.description3.message: . You keep your stack - the host handles auth, permissions, and device access.

homepage.playground.title.message: Try the playground before you ship

homepage.playground.description.message: Call any sdk.* method with a mock transport, inspect request/response shapes, and copy the snippet into your mini app. Built from packages/sdk-playground - no extra install.

homepage.final.subtitle.message: Scaffold from test-mini-app/, read the platform overview, or dive straight into the API reference.
